_comment: Settings per image model, used by ai gen (--model <name>). Starting values come from each model's card;
Phase 3 tunes them on the RTX 4080 Laptop. Add a model: put its file in models.txt (or D:\AI\models\comfy\...),
add an entry here with its architecture and settings, push, dev mod update comfyui.
arch: sdxl = works with --pose/--face/--fix-*/--hires (SDXL ControlNet, IPAdapter FaceID, FaceDetailer).
arch: flux3 / zimage / anima = newer models with their own workflows (flux3 also does ai gen edit).

Defaults chosen 1 Nov 2026 from a side-by-side test on the RTX 4080 laptop: zimage for plain images, juggernaut when SDXL-only tools are used, flux3 for edits/text/complex scenes, anima for illustration.

photo.negative: cartoon, painting, illustration, 3d render, cgi, plastic skin, airbrushed, smooth skin, doll, oversaturated, bad hands, bad anatomy, deformed, face asymmetry, eyes asymmetry, deformed eyes, blurry, low quality, watermark, text

art.negative: blurry, low quality, jpeg artifacts, watermark, signature, text, bad anatomy, deformed, extra fingers, extra limbs

negative.photo: blurry, low quality, watermark, text, deformed hands

juggernaut.about: photoreal, natural documentary look, strong scenes
juggernaut.source: civitai.com/models/133005 (Ragnarok: DPM++ 2M SDE, 30-40 steps, CFG 3-6, start with little negative)

sdxl-base.about: original SDXL: general and artistic, weakest at photos

flux3.about: FLUX 3 Image Klein: prompt-faithful, text in images, edits (ai gen edit); caption expanded by the local model
flux3.licence: FLUX Kommunity License (non-commercial; commercial-output exception for qualifying users)

zimage.source: huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Z-Image-Turbo + Comfy blueprint Text to Image (Z-Image-Turbo) (8 steps, CFG 1, res_multistep, shift 3)

negative.art: worst quality, low quality, score_1, score_2, score_3, blurry, jpeg artifacts, sepia
negative.photo: worst quality, low quality, score_1, score_2, score_3, blurry, jpeg artifacts, sepia

anima.about: Anima Aesthetic: anime / illustration (tags or plain text), --pose works
anima.source: huggingface.co/circlestone-labs/Anima + Comfy template image_anima (30 steps, CFG 4, er_sde, simple)

anima-turbo.about: Anima Turbo: fast drafts (8-12 steps, CFG 1)

negative.photo: nsfw, worst quality, bad anatomy, watermark, jpeg artifact
negative.art: nsfw, worst quality, bad anatomy, watermark, jpeg artifact

moss.about: MOSS-Image SFT: legible text in images (posters, signs, infographics), 1-2 MP
moss.source: huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MOSS-Image + Comfy template image_moss_image_t2i (25 steps, CFG 2.5, er_sde, simple)

fibo2.about: Fibo 2.0 Edit Turbo: edits with up to 4 references (ai gen edit --model fibo2), also text-to-image; about 1 MP
fibo2.licence: CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial unless you have a Bria agreement)
fibo2.source: huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Fibo-2.0 + Comfy template image_fibo2_edit_turbo_pe (4 steps, CFG 1, euler, simple, empty negative)

pixal3d.about: Pixal3D: one picture to a textured 3D model (GLB, PBR); geometry follows the photo closely

trellis2.about: TRELLIS.2 (Microsoft): one picture to a textured 3D model; fallback to pixal3d

pixal3d-mv.about: Pixal3D multi-view: up to 4 views (front, left, back, right - e.g. a character turnaround) to one textured 3D model

ultrasharp.about: Declared ComfyUI upscaler component; used by supported image workflows
